nodes.description: List of Redfish nodes to fence. Each node specifies connection details and default behavior for fence operations.

name.description: Human-readable identifier for the Redfish node (e.g., server hostname or rack position).

ipaddr.description: IP address or hostname of the Redfish Baseboard Management Controller (BMC).

login.description: Username to authenticate with the Redfish BMC.

passwd.description: Password for the Redfish BMC user. Store securely (e.g., via vault or file permissions).

port.description: Redfish BMC port (typically '443' for HTTPS, '8080' or '80' for HTTP). Leave empty for default.

secure.description: Use HTTPS (true) or HTTP (false) for communication with the Redfish BMC.

action.description: Default fence action when not specified (e.g., 'on', 'off', 'reboot', 'status').

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a fence operation to complete before timing out.
